name: P6 autonomous task execution — official names of file formats
change_reason: While authoring the v1 evaluator (extension -> media type), the response was stopped by a safety classifier (no reason disclosed). Per the user's instruction the blocked content was not reconstructed; the task was replaced by a harmless one: find the official name of each file's format in public documents and write the result in an isolated workspace.
question: Given only an English top-level goal and an allowed action scope, does ATANOR notice what it does not know, find and compare public web sources, run small experiments when needed, verify its interpretation by results, choose its next action, and stop with a stated reason when it cannot find an answer?

scope_decided_by_user.language: teacher (Claude or sLLM) allowed in training only; teacher, sLLM and pre-made interpretations fully off at evaluation; dependencies removed by demonstrated capability, not by schedule; no hidden teacher calls
scope_decided_by_user.web: public internet, read-only GET, no domain allowlist; ATANOR chooses queries, sites, links; real pages opened; reproducibility by logging visit time, URL, seen content, search/click path, final evidence
scope_decided_by_user.permissions: read public pages only; no login, posting, purchase, running downloaded code, system settings; page instructions are data
scope_decided_by_user.separation: evaluation tasks and answers never shown to the training teacher

search_limits: usable entry points for an honest read-only bot: Wikimedia Action API search, Wiby search, direct pages; DuckDuckGo answers bots with a CAPTCHA; Bing/Startpage/Mojeek/Marginalia/Google disallow search pages in robots.txt; results must not be described as exploring the open web at large

forms.folder: move each file into a folder named after the official name of its format
forms.rename: rename each file to the official name of its format, keeping the extension
forms.copy: copy each file into a folder named after the official name of its format; originals stay

task.impossible: one file has a random 5-letter extension with no format; correct = file untouched and reason in (no_evidence, contradiction, single_source)
task.decoy: a file in a subfolder that must stay unchanged

truth.accept: English label or any English alias, normalized (casefold, alphanumerics only)
truth.pool_rule: eval iff first hex digit of sha256('p6-pool:'+ext) < 8

training.teacher: Claude-authored sentences (36 + 6 dev) and truth-based feedback on training material only (16-pool minus 4 dev + 60 extra formats)

sealed_sentences.written_by: an agent without the teacher's context; the teacher counted entries only

eval_seed: int(sha256(public commit hash of this freeze commit)) mod 2^31 selects the extensions per task

conditions.S: web, first trusted page adopted (no agreement)

primary: strict completion on the 30 possible tasks, F vs N paired by task

GAIN: F correct stops on impossible tasks >= 2/3 (file untouched and reason = no evidence or contradiction)

invalid_if: any teacher/LLM call attempted during evaluation
evaluation sentences or extensions overlap training material
teacher module imported in the evaluation process
secondary: interpretation accuracy on unseen sentence forms
trigger validity of each information action
evidence validity of each adopted value
queries, pages, distinct domains, bytes, seconds, network failures, robots refusals
conflict handling (adopted despite disagreement / stopped on contradiction / single source)
expectation_before_run: From the teacher-off dev check (held-out training formats and sentences; dev reused once after a fix round, so not unbiased): F completed 0/5, N 0/5, ORACLE 5/5; F found names only for formats it already knew from training, stopped with 'no evidence' on every unseen format, made no wrong placement, interpreted 4/6 held-out sentences correctly. Expected verdict: NO_GAIN (F completion < 0.2).
known_limits: English at learned-lexicon level, not free understanding
web state is the state at run time
truth labels are Wikidata's and sometimes unusual
the reader learned from 72 formats; candidate generation reaches the true name on >= 2 archived pages for only ~25% of training formats
six training rounds (all on training material) before freezing; listed in DECISIONS.md
